description: Rename a key, change its note, move its expiry earlier, or lower its per-minute limit. Works on keys created through an API key and on the calling key itself; keys created in the console can only be disabled. Needs the keys:write account scope, which is off by default and can only be granted by the account owner in the console.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601; can only be earlier than now set

name: everyinfra_key_update
title: Update an API key
